text: Ah this might be nothing at all but I'd rather ask. Foster son, 6 months. Temp is 38.2. He's teething something terrible, drooling everywhere, gnawing on anything he can get his hands on and one cheek is gone red. Earlier he whacked his head off the table when I was holding him, he roared crying straight off and then he was grand after, back to himself completely. Had a look all over him and there's no rash. I think it's probably just the teeth but with the bump as well I wasn't sure, so thought I'd check.
